review_scope: parallel preparation plus dependency-independent prebuild readiness; not production integration or approval

internal_review.reviewer_type: internal review; no separate critic runtime claimed
internal_review.pass_rule: > 9.0 with all mandatory checks for the reviewed scope passing

checks.name: T10 frozen scope exists and separates T10 framework from T11 camp content
Dependencies fixed to T05/T08/T09 and production activation refuses unresolved dependency state
T10 prebuild ownership remains disjoint from active T09 reservation
T10 prebuild excludes integration-only main/simulation paths
C1/C2/C3/C4/C6/C7 production critic contract remains unchanged
Two-phase transaction waits for simulation-authoritative debit receipt before world-state advancement
Pending/completed replay, crash recovery, altered receipt rejection and component-state fail-closed import pass
One in-flight transaction per target prevents same-revision double-debit race
Authoritative receipts must match a T10-prepared transaction; unsolicited receipts fail closed
512 targets / 1024 two-stage transactions pass bounded stress and exact snapshot round-trip
Fixture simulation integration passes same-target race, stale-authority, crash-window and out-of-order multi-target receipt cases
Full frozen source-contract validator passes with formal domain/integration/capture files present
Eight 1280x720 lifecycle fixture renders are distinct and readable across front and three-quarter views
Governance, migration and production-tool regression pass on the exact verified prebuild source

resolved_prebuild_defects.defect: Initial commit_transform advanced world state before the simulation-authoritative resource debit was confirmed.
resolved_prebuild_defects.risk: A debit failure or crash could split inventory state from world transformation state.
resolved_prebuild_defects.repair: Converted to two-phase prepare -> simulation debit -> T10 receipt validation -> world advancement; pending transactions persist and replay idempotently.
resolved_prebuild_defects.verification: Repaired core passed the formal domain, crash/recovery and fixture integration suites.

resolved_prebuild_defects.defect: Presentation could have trusted a merely simulation-shaped receipt before T10 accepted it.
resolved_prebuild_defects.risk: Visual completion could get ahead of authoritative world state.
resolved_prebuild_defects.repair: Presentation completion requires a receipt stamped accepted_by_world_transform by T10.
resolved_prebuild_defects.verification: Raw simulation receipts are rejected by the completion lifecycle test; T10-accepted receipts complete successfully.

resolved_prebuild_defects.defect: Two different transaction IDs could be prepared against the same target revision before the first receipt returned.
resolved_prebuild_defects.risk: Both intents could debit resources even though only one world-state receipt could later win.
resolved_prebuild_defects.repair: Enforced one_inflight_transaction_per_target and reject later target transactions with target_transaction_pending until the first resolves.
resolved_prebuild_defects.verification: Fixture integration proves the second same-target request is rejected before the simulation debit count changes.

resolved_prebuild_defects.defect: A well-formed simulation receipt for a transaction T10 never prepared could be accepted.
resolved_prebuild_defects.risk: Out-of-band authoritative-looking input could advance T10 world state.
resolved_prebuild_defects.repair: accept_authoritative_receipt now requires the exact transaction in prepared and exact prepared-intent field equality.
resolved_prebuild_defects.verification: Fixture integration rejects unsolicited valid-looking simulation receipts with missing_prepared_transaction.

resolved_prebuild_defects.defect: Initial lifecycle capture harness used untyped local inference from dynamically typed engine calls and failed GDScript parsing.
resolved_prebuild_defects.risk: Rendered evidence could not be produced even though domain/integration gates passed.
resolved_prebuild_defects.repair: Added explicit Dictionary typing for preview, intent and accepted receipt locals.
resolved_prebuild_defects.verification: Exact-source Xvfb + software Vulkan/mobile capture produced eight unique 1280x720 PNGs and a passing manifest.

runtime_blockers.effect: T10 dependency-independent prebuild may remain isolated, but T10 may not be production-integrated or approved and the real T09 adapter cannot be certified yet.
runtime_blockers.resolution: Complete T09, then run prepare_activation.py --activate --base <exact-post-T09-integration-head>; reconcile the prebuild and bind the real approved T09/T08 simulation interfaces.

remaining_after_dependency_resolves: Reconcile this prebuild onto the exact post-T09 integration head.
Run T10 activation preflight and stage validated ownership/registry/dependency/task-gate activation.
Replace FakeSimulationAuthority/fixture assumptions with the real approved T09/T08 simulation adapter and rerun the formal integration suite.
Run impacted T01-T09 regressions, final save/recovery/device/performance evidence and production capture.
Run independent required C1/C2/C3/C4/C6/C7 reviews and fix/retest until every mandatory dimension is strictly >9.0 unrounded.
